notes: This contract pins timestamped Send Interaction to the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ API for the multi-recipient source-resignation case. Companion API-reference contracts pin resignation, retraction, alternate time advances, and timestamped receive callbacks. The source uses only standard RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; adapter inputs provide the provider, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies queued delivery to independent recipients after producer resignation without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual MessageRetractionHandle sendInteraction( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass, ParameterHandleValueMap const & parameterValues, VariableLengthData const & userSuppliedTag, LogicalTime const & time) = 0
